name: What factors influence the total cost of a backsplash installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the total cost of a backsplash installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen backsplash depends primarily on the square footage, the material selected, and the complexity of the tile pattern. Intricate designs like herringbone, chevron, or small mosaic sheets require significantly more cutting and labor than standard subway tile. Additional cost factors include wall surface repairs, the removal and disposal of existing tile, and the number of electrical outlets that require box extenders to sit flush with the new tile depth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Total cost depends on square footage, tile material, pattern complexity, wall surface prep, and the number of electrical outlets requiring adjustment.
